title: Digit 0
desc: Unit digit (height 1, centred on its box, +z out of the plate): bevelled extrusion of Arial Black. Scale by number_height; tint by replacing vertex colours.
convention: Digit meshes: unit height, centred on their box, +z out of the plate, depth ~0.06. Place at bib.number_anchor_rest with the plate normal (bib.number_normal), scale by bib.number_height (0.24). Colours are baked cream: replace vertex colours to tint (team colour deep shade).
